chunks.content: OpenAI released GPT-5 (with GPT-5 mini) on 2025-08-07, available to free users immediately — a deliberate shift to give-away-the-frontier pricing. GPT-5 retired the separate o-series products: o3, o4-mini, o3-mini and o3-pro were folded into GPT-5's internal "reasoning modes"; OpenAI's pitch was "GPT-5 is not a 'reasoning model'; it's a model that thinks" — one model, no model picker. The features: a 5-million-token context window, native image generation built in (no separate image model), deep research integrated, and file upload and web search out of the box. Pricing: free on the free tier; Plus $20/month (unlimited GPT-5); Pro $200/month; API pricing $1.25 / $10 per million tokens for GPT-5 and $0.25 / $2 for GPT-5 mini. GPT-5 scored about 78.6% on SWE-bench Verified, with GPT-5 mini close behind — both at a fraction of the o-series prices. The launch consolidated OpenAI's strategy around one unified model plus aggressive free-tier distribution: the reasoning-vs-non-reasoning split ended, price collapsed, and the competitive battleground moved from benchmark demos to default agency — models that act, not models that answer.

prior_gap_texts: OpenAI released GPT-5 on August 7, 2025 [Source: ev-1], marking a deliberate strategic shift toward "give-away-the-frontier" pricing and aggressive free-tier distribution [Source: ev-1].

The release consolidated the company's model lineup by retiring separate o-series products (o3, o4-mini, o3-mini, and o3-pro) and folding their capabilities into GPT-5’s internal reasoning modes, effectively ending the distinction between reasoning and non-reasoning models in favor of a single unified model that "thinks" rather than requiring users to select from multiple options [Source: ev-1].

This change fundamentally altered how OpenAI sells its models through several key mechanisms:
*   **Pricing Structure:** GPT-5 is available for free on the free tier immediately upon launch. [Source: ev-1]

Paid tiers include Plus at $20/month with unlimited access to GPT-5, Pro at $200/month, and API pricing set at $1.25 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens for GPT-5 (with GPT-5 mini priced at $0.25/$2) [Source: ev-1].
This represented a significant price collapse compared to previous o-series offerings [Source: ev-1].

*   **Product Integration:** The model features a 5-million-token context window, native image generation without requiring separate models, integrated deep research, and built-in file upload and web search capabilities [Source: ev-1].
GPT-5 achieved approximately 78.6% on SWE-bench Verified at a fraction of previous prices [Source: ev-1].
